description_excerpt: Main Tasks: • Creates and confirms transport order to ensure pickup of the shipment at origin • Performs booking and booking optimization according to internal guidelines as defined by Product • Prepares, controls and distributes all required Import/ Export documents to counterparts (carrier, consignee, supplier, etc.) complying with regulations and internal procedures • Checks responses from counterparts and finalizes validation of required documents • Follows-up shipment status in the Import/ Export area • Supports Customer Service in the incident and exception management resolution •…
